entries.en: Examine the overgrown leafmen and obtain leaves.
entries.ja: モサモサ草人を調べ、を入手
entries.jaMacro: モサモサ草人を調べ、<sheet(EventItem,2002925,0)>を入手
entries.section: Allied Society Quests (A Realm Reborn through Endwalker)

entries.en: Deliver the leafmen's leaves to Uin Nee.
entries.fr: Apporter les branchettes à Uin Nee
entries.section: Allied Society Quests (A Realm Reborn through Endwalker)

entries.en: Oh, but which of them was my favorite? Is it the one who once tried to sneak up on me and pluck my wings? Or the one who was just so cute when he confessed his love to me that I simply had to keep him by my side forever and a day!
entries.macro: Oh, but which of them was my favorite? Is it the one who once tried to sneak up on me and pluck my wings? Or the one who was just <italic(1)>so<italic(0)> cute when he confessed his love to me that I simply <italic(1)>had<italic(0)> to keep him by my side forever and a day!
entries.fr: Hé,  ! J'ai une faveur à te demander... Tu connais déjà nos mignons petits enfeuillés, hein ?
entries.ja:
ねぇさん、お願いがあるの！
ワタシたちのカワイイ草人は知っているでしょう？

entries.en: You've seen my collection of delightful little leafmen, have you not? Always basking blithely in the light of the sun, sprouting new fronds here, there, and everywhere!
entries.fr: Comme tu le sais, l'exercice, c'est pas leur fort... Ils passent leurs journées à se dorer la pilule au soleil, et leurs branches poussent à vue d'œil. Si on s'occupe pas d'eux, ils finissent vite par ressembler à des buissons !
entries.ja:
いつもお日さまの光を浴びて、気持ちよさそうにしているけど、
おかげで体の枝葉もボウボウに伸び放題……
むさ苦しいったらありゃしないわ！

entries.en: I had a mind to give them a little trim from time to time, but pointy objects are too prickly and perilous for my liking, don't you know. But you, my favorite mortal─you don't seem the type to be bothered by blades and shears, now do you?
entries.macro: I had a mind to give them a little trim from time to time, but pointy objects are too prickly and perilous for my liking, don't you know. But <italic(1)>you<italic(0)>, my favorite mortal─you don't seem the type to be bothered by blades and shears, now do you?
entries.fr: Je ferais bien une petite coupe branchée aux enfeuillés touffus de Lydha Lran, mais j'ai une peur bleue des objets coupants. Tu veux bien aller les élaguer à ma place ?
entries.ja:
刈って整えてあげたいけど、ワタシ、鉄の刃物を使うのは苦手なの。
あの子たちのところをまわって、
「モサモサ草人」を可愛く整えてきてくれないかしら？

entries.en: So why don't you run along and give my foliating friends a little trim? And don't forget to bring back some of their pretty little leaves! The children in the Garden of Dreams do so much love to pile them up and jump inside!
entries.fr: Ah, et oublie pas de me ramener quelques branchettes que tu auras coupées ! Je m'en servirai pour construire quelque chose de mignon dans les prochains rêves dont je m'occuperai. Hi hi hi, j'ai hâte !♪
entries.ja:
刈り取ったは、
夢に持ち込むものの材料にするから、持ち帰ってきてね。
それじゃあ、よろしく頼むわっ♪

entries.en: Abundant green foliage sprouts from every nook and cranny of the leafman's body, such that many of the leaves and branches have become matted and tangled together.
entries.fr: La ramure hirsute de cet enfeuillé est la preuve qu'il est en pleine santé.
entries.ja:
草人の体から、元気よく枝葉が飛び出している。
なんとも生命力を感じる有り様だ。
entries.jaMacro:
草人の体から、元気よく枝葉が飛び出している。
なんとも生命力を感じる有り様だ。
entries.section: Allied Society Quests (A Realm Reborn through Endwalker)

entries.en: With a few snips, you remove the overgrowth from the leafman's body, leaving it looking as prim and trim as the day it was born!
entries.fr: Vous avez coupé ses branches disgracieuses, ce qui lui a redonné sa forme arrondie si caractéristique !
entries.ja: 余分な枝葉を刈り取って、草人らしい丸いフォルムを取り戻した！
entries.frMacro: Vous avez coupé ses branches disgracieuses, ce qui lui a redonné sa forme arrondie si ca<->rac<->té<->ris<->ti<->que<nbsp>!
entries.section: Allied Society Quests (A Realm Reborn through Endwalker)

entries.en: Was there something you needed? Oh, but of course! You were going to prune my precious little leafmen for me. Well, did you?
entries.fr: À ces brindilles et autres feuilles sur tes vêtements, je devine que tu as refait une beauté aux enfeuillés touffus ! Tu en as profité pour ramasser quelques branchettes ?
entries.ja:
ありがとう、草人を整えてきてくれたのね！
も、持ってきてくれたかしら？
entries.frMacro: À ces brindilles et autres feuilles sur tes vêtements, je devine que tu as refait une beauté aux enfeuillés touffus<nbsp>! Tu en as profité pour ramasser quelques branchettes<nbsp>?
entries.jaMacro:
ありがとう、草人を整えてきてくれたのね！
も、持ってきてくれたかしら？
entries.speaker: UINNEE
entries.section: Allied Society Quests (A Realm Reborn through Endwalker)

entries.en: Thank you ever so much! I knew there was a reason why you were my favorite mortal. Oooh, and look at these lovely fronds you've brought back for me! Why, perhaps I'll spin them into a little leafman for the children!
entries.fr: Oh, ça fera largement l'affaire ! Je vais leur lancer un petit sort dont j'ai le secret pour en faire de jolis pantins de bois. Comme ça, je pourrai les emmener dans les rêves pour ravir les enfants !
entries.ja:
うんうん、これだけあれば十分だわ！
この枝葉に魔法をかけて、夢の中に持ち込む人形にするのよ。
もとがヒトだからかしら、活き活きしてカワイイんだから！

entries.en: Some of them don't have so many friends, you know? It truly breaks my heart to see. And so I'll fashion them a whole horde of leafmen to play with! They should get along swimmingly─after all, the leafmen used to be mortals, too!
entries.fr: Il y a beaucoup de bambins qui se sentent seuls et ignorent comment se faire des amis, tu sais ? J'aimerais vraiment qu'ils arrivent à oublier tous leurs soucis, au moins dans leurs songes !
entries.ja:
ワタシたちが夢で遊ぶ子どもは、寂しがりやさんが多いの。
夢の中に、たくさんの友だちを用意してあげたら、
いっぱい遊べて、きっと喜んでくれるわ！

entries.en: Sometimes I wonder what it's like to be a leafman. Have you ever wondered, too? If you have, why, that could certainly be arranged! You need only say the─wait, why are you backing away from me like that?
entries.fr: C'est pas la dernière fois qu'on entendra parler d'enfeuillés un peu trop garnis, donc je compte sur toi pour leur faire une coupe légère quand y aura besoin. À bientôt, hi hi !♪
entries.ja:
ウフフっ♪
また草人の枝葉が伸びてきちゃったら、お願いさせてね！
